local_limits_required_for: Hot compact and custody payloads, including the chain boundary and replay dependencies
Processed and v2 SQLite pages, indexes, WAL and checkpoint working space
Catalog roots, shard indexes and the decoded shard cache
Restored payloads held by reader leases
Validator accounts, account shrink, ledger and snapshot overlap
A separate cloud outage buffer sized from measured input
host_budget.admission_rule: The sum of enforced local limits and measured maximum concurrent working space must fit below filesystem capacity minus the protected capture reserve. Include the next snapshot and outage buffer; do not count their space twice.

retirement_requirements: All deployed readers use the shared resolver before local markers can be removed.
Full cloud readback and durable source-bound catalog root commit before local retirement.
Keep current age, replay, publication, native ACK, digest and stable-file checks.
Define hot-window eviction for processed and v2 SQLite separately.
Preserve unresolved banks, current chain boundary, competing banks and late callback proof.
Add reader leases before restored payload cache eviction.
acceptance: Restore all 16 original files after both metadata directories are absent; match every original hash.
Reject wrong source, namespace, marker hash, bundle hash, duplicate path and unsafe path.
Resume after interruption at every commit and removal boundary.
Check late duplicate and conflicting callbacks, competing roots and restart lookup.
Preserve old-cursor expiry behavior and exact current source.
Measure allocated files, SQLite pages, WAL, indexes and caches over at least two hot-window lengths.
Observe a full snapshot write and purge cycle, including concurrent account shrink and local staging space.
Prove the host peak-space budget and outage-buffer behavior before claiming stable total disk use.

raw_shreds.custody: Archive exact sealed packet segments with source, sequence and prefix-hash provenance; fully read back before any approved local retirement. Do not claim canonical or complete shred coverage.
raw_shreds.quota: Use retained allocated bytes after acknowledged retirement, rather than a cumulative process-lifetime byte count.
raw_shreds.transport: A tested reconnect state machine must open a new capture and record the gap. The current raw hook remains latched until a validator restart.

unresolved_forks_and_failed_sources.custody: Store unresolved evidence in a separate noncanonical tier. Keep source identity, exact bytes, partial-session state and explicit gaps.
unresolved_forks_and_failed_sources.retirement: Requires an explicit evidence-retention contract. A failed or unrooted bank alone does not authorize deletion.

cloud_outage.policy: Size a separate bounded outage buffer from measured input rate. Pause optional and bulk input first. If the protected buffer is exhausted, keep explicit failure and gap records; do not silently drop data or lower the validator reserve.
